create_handover_env: create a HandOver environment instance with default config for ALOHA box handover task
build_handover_config: build a default config dict for the HandOver ALOHA manipulation task with reward scales and simulation parameters
run_handover_step: run a single step of the HandOver environment with an action array and return the next state
test_handover_reset: test the HandOver environment reset method with a JAX random key to initialize box and target positions
review_logistic_barrier: review the logistic_barrier function that computes a smooth penalty based on position relative to a threshold
